<!-- Generated by Chanks (personal configuration) — not part of Control Tower -->
## Session-start main freshness check

At the first user message of a session whose working directory is inside a Git repository,
run `$HOME/.local/bin/main-al-dia` once. Skip this silently when the script is unavailable.

- **OK or SKIP:** say nothing about it and continue with the request.
- **BEHIND:** before the request, tell the user in one short line what is behind and ask ONE
  question — update first, or continue as is — then stop and wait for the answer.
- On update, only fast-forward:
  - default branch not checked out: `git fetch origin <b>:<b>`;
  - checked out here or in another worktree: `git -C <that worktree> merge --ff-only origin/<b>`;
  - current branch behind a clean upstream: `git merge --ff-only @{u}`.
- Never stash, reset, rebase, force or discard. If the tree is dirty, the branches diverged,
  or the fast-forward fails, stop and explain plainly.

Do not repeat the check later in the same session. Subagents never run it.
